{% translate "The Dashboard" %}

{% blocktranslate trimmed %} When you log in to the admin portal, you will be presented with the dashboard for the site that your OS2borgerPC user is associated with. If you have access to multiple sites, you will first be presented with the sites overview where you must choose a site to access. {% endblocktranslate %}

{% translate "The dashboard provides an overview of certain relevant information for the site." %}

{% translate "Latest unhandled events" %}

{% blocktranslate trimmed %} This section shows up to five of the most recent unhandled events and the times when they occurred. Events with the level "Normal" are not shown. The "See all"-button links to the events overview. {% endblocktranslate %}

{% translate "Latest failed jobs" %}

{% blocktranslate trimmed %} This section shows up to five of the most recent failed jobs and the times when they finished. If a failed job is no longer relevant, you can click on the "slashed eye"-icon to hide it. Doing so will cause that job to no longer be shown on the dashboard. It will still be shown on the job list. You can also click on the "Hide all shown jobs"-button to hide all the jobs currently shown on the dashboard. You will be asked for confirmation when hiding failed jobs. The "See all"-button links to the job list filtered to only show failed jobs. {% endblocktranslate %}

{% translate "Latest news" %}

{% blocktranslate trimmed %} This section shows the five most recent news and the times when they were uploaded. The "See all"-button links to the news page. {% endblocktranslate %}

{% translate "Computers that haven't checked in in 15 minutes" %}

{% blocktranslate trimmed %} This section shows up to five computers that most recently went offline for more than 15 minutes, the time since their last check in and the time of their last check in. The "See status overview"-button links to the computer status overview. {% endblocktranslate %}

{% translate "Newest global scripts" %}

{% blocktranslate trimmed %} This section shows the five newest global scripts. The "See all scripts"-button links to the scripts overview. {% endblocktranslate %}

{% translate "Active computers that have not run all updates for more than 30 days" %}

{% blocktranslate trimmed %} This section shows up to five active computers that have not run all updates for more than 30 days and the time since they last ran all updates. The computers that have not run all updates for the longest time are shown first. A computer is considered active if it has checked in within the last 28 days. {% endblocktranslate %}
